S: the bar where they sing to Charlie
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and a little honey, blue cheese dip and celery sticks.
Flathead strips in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime crema and pico de gallo.
Goose hammering out a rock and roll classic on the bar piano

Smashed beef sliders with melted cheddar, sticky butter onions, pickles and a hot mustard mayo on soft milk rolls, served on a tray for the whole bar. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp American mustard and a dash of hot sauce. Smash the balls thin on a smoking griddle, season, cook 90 seconds, flip and top with cheddar. Fill 12 toasted milk rolls with patties, onions, pickles and the mustard mayo.
M: Maverick turns up at Charlie's for dinner
Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with a Greek salad and warm pita.
the base at Miramar, San Diego

Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, seared over very high heat and sliced, with charred spring onions, Mexican rice, black beans and salsa roja. Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes and an orange, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt for 2 hours. Cook 300g rice with 2 tbsp tomato paste and 600ml stock. Warm a drained tin of black beans with cumin. Sear the steak on very high heat 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin against the grain. Char 2 bunches spring onions. Serve with salsa roja.
W: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into rectangles, drizzled with a glossy dark chocolate glaze so they shine.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup frozen into a sharp slush, topped with ice-cold lager in frosted glasses for a frozen lemon beer float. Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80ml sugar syrup and 200ml water and freeze in a shallow tray for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush. Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Spoon the lemon slush into the frosted glasses and top each with 250ml ice-cold lager.

s.note: the bar where they sing to Charlie
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with 80g blue cheese mashed into 150g sour cream and celery sticks.

Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with lime. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, diced tomato and onion.

m.note: Maverick turns up at Charlie's for dinner
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lemon, 3 garlic cloves and oregano for an hour and grill until charred. Toss tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and 150g feta for a Greek salad. Serve with 4 warm pita.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into rectangles and drizzle with 80g chocolate melted with a knob of butter.

d.how: Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80ml sugar syrup and 200ml water and freeze in a shallow tray for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush. Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Spoon the lemon slush into the frosted glasses and top each with 250ml ice-cold lager.
